verdict.rationale: Lever offers several discrete AI-powered features (AI Form Builder that generates forms from descriptions, AI-generated interview guides/questions, AI interview transcripts/summaries, Talent Fit matching, Automation Hub for routine task handling) that let users delegate specific tasks to AI, but there is no evidence of a unified conversational 'AI assistant' interface for general task delegation. Missing for 10: a single built-in assistant/chat interface, evidence of open-ended task delegation beyond fixed AI features, independent/hands-on corroboration of these AI features in use.
